metadata.description: Wire format for the `lifecycle_tasks` durable handoff report (R7.4 MCP/CLI): what validated lifecycle state owes the hosting agent. Source of truth for `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/lifecycle_tasks/`.

The durable handoff verdict over `.vibe/lifecycle.toml`. `absent` means no state file exists and is the ONLY status that omits `run`; `idle` means valid state with no delegated row — it carries `run` and an empty `tasks`; `parked` means valid state with delegated rows — it carries `run`, a valid run id and a nonempty `tasks`. This status ↔ run/tasks/run-id relation is enforced in Rust over the generated types (the corpus behavior cell): JTD cannot express it.

One row per typed `delegated` execution, ordered by the durable chain's phase order with the execution key as tie-break — never by directory enumeration or filename parsing. Emitted even when empty (`absent`, `idle`).
The state file's run header, carried for both `idle` and `parked`; only `absent` omits it.
The run header the existing state record already carries; `lifecycle_tasks` restates it, it never mints a second run identity.
The exact default-lifecycle phase the run requested.
The run's full requested phase chain, in order.
The durable 32-lowercase-hex run identity the outbox tasks live under. `parked` requires it (relationally checked in Rust, not expressible in JTD); a state no run delegated may omit it.

The canonical forward-slashed workspace-relative selected-node identity (`.` for the workspace root) — it names the node root that interprets `tasks[].path`. Optional only so readable legacy idle state (pre-R7.4 files without it) still parses; every new write carries it, and `parked` requires it (relationally checked in Rust).
One delegated execution the hosting agent owes: its identity, the plan that parked it, and its exact task document.
The delegated row's execution key, verbatim from state.
The phase whose plan delegated this row.
Which plan owns the park — recorded by the engine, never inferred by parsing the execution key or a task filename.

The validated state-owned outbox task path — the one file `(run id, execution key)` deterministically owns. It is carried relative to the SELECTED NODE root and interpreted against it (`selected` names that root): the spelling is the unchanged `.vibe/agentic/outbox/<run>/<task>` rel for every member, root or not — never re-spelled with `..` segments, never made absolute, and never relative to the workspace state root.
The exact bounded UTF-8 task document — frontmatter with the ordered output contract plus the verbatim system/request prose. Never reparsed outputs or a second DTO.
